list.name: anomaly_count_text
list.query: SELECT COUNT(*)::text AS "value" FROM agent_runs WHERE anomaly_flag = true;

list.name: action_success_text
list.query: SELECT COUNT(*)::text AS "value" FROM action_log WHERE success = true;

list.name: total_saving_text
list.query:
WITH action_durations AS (
    SELECT
        al.resource_id,
        al.executed_at,
        (elem->>'estimated_saving_usd')::float AS hourly_saving,
        LEAD(al.executed_at) OVER (
            PARTITION BY al.resource_id ORDER BY al.executed_at
        ) AS next_action_at
    FROM action_log al
    JOIN agent_runs ar ON al.run_id = ar.run_id
    JOIN agent_steps s ON s.run_id = ar.run_id AND s.step_name = 'decision'
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.output->'candidate_actions') AS elem
    WHERE elem->>'action' = ar.selected_action
      AND al.success = true
      AND $__timeFilter(al.executed_at)
),
total_saving AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
        hourly_saving * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(next_action_at, now()) - executed_at)) / 3600
    ), 0) AS saving
    FROM action_durations
),
edos_avoided AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(avoided_cost_usd * 720), 0) AS avoided
    FROM agent_runs
    WHERE resource_type = 'AutoScaling'
      AND avoided_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
      AND $__timeFilter(finished_at)
)
SELECT ROUND((total_saving.saving + edos_avoided.avoided)::numeric, 6)::text AS "value"
FROM total_saving, edos_avoided;

panels.title: 시스템 미적용 시 예상 비용 (30일 기준 추정)
panels.description: [2026-09-28 라이브 복원] EC2+S3만 있던 통제실험 고정값에서, zombie/ec2_over/s3/lambda/edos 5개 시나리오 실연동 결과를 실시간 반영하는 원래 쿼리로 복원 (Lambda까지 합산되면 원복 예정이라던 계획대로).

targets.rawSql:
WITH action_durations AS (
    SELECT
        al.resource_id,
        al.executed_at,
        (elem->>'estimated_saving_usd')::float AS hourly_saving,
        LEAD(al.executed_at) OVER (
            PARTITION BY al.resource_id ORDER BY al.executed_at
        ) AS next_action_at
    FROM action_log al
    JOIN agent_runs ar ON al.run_id = ar.run_id
    JOIN agent_steps s ON s.run_id = ar.run_id AND s.step_name = 'decision'
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.output->'candidate_actions') AS elem
    WHERE elem->>'action' = ar.selected_action
      AND al.success = true
      AND $__timeFilter(al.executed_at)
),
total_saving AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
        hourly_saving * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(next_action_at, now()) - executed_at)) / 3600
    ), 0) AS saving
    FROM action_durations
),
actual_cost AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM((s.output->>'latest_cost')::float), 0) AS cost
    FROM agent_steps s
    JOIN agent_runs ar ON ar.run_id = s.run_id
    WHERE s.step_name = 'detection'
      AND s.output->>'latest_cost' IS NOT NULL
      AND $__timeFilter(ar.finished_at)
)
SELECT ROUND((actual_cost.cost + total_saving.saving)::numeric, 6) AS "value"
FROM actual_cost, total_saving;

panels.title: 시스템 적용 시 실측 비용
panels.description: [2026-09-28 라이브 복원] EC2+S3만 있던 통제실험 고정값에서, 5개 시나리오 실연동 결과를 실시간 반영하는 원래 쿼리로 복원.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(ROUND(SUM((s.output->>'latest_cost')::float)::numeric, 6), 0) AS "value"
FROM agent_steps s
JOIN agent_runs ar ON ar.run_id = s.run_id
WHERE s.step_name = 'detection'
  AND s.output->>'latest_cost' IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(ar.finished_at);

panels.title: 비용 절감액 (30일 기준 추정)
panels.description: [2026-09-29] EDoS(AutoScaling ScaleDown+WAF)는 공격을 막는 시점에 desired_capacity가 이미 낮아 실측 절감액이 거의 0으로 나온다 — EDoS에 한해 "공격을 막지 않았다면 MaxSize까지 늘어났을 때 발생했을 회피 예상 비용"(avoided_cost_usd × 720h)을 이 합계에 같이 더한다. 다른 리소스(EC2/S3/Lambda)는 기존과 동일하게 실측 기반 절감액만 반영된다.

    WHERE elem->>'action' = ar.selected_action

total_saving AS (

        hourly_saving * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(next_action_at, now()) - executed_at)) / 3600
    ), 0) AS saving
    FROM action_durations
),
edos_avoided AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(avoided_cost_usd * 720), 0) AS avoided
    FROM agent_runs
    WHERE resource_type = 'AutoScaling'
      AND avoided_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
      AND $__timeFilter(finished_at)
)
SELECT ROUND((total_saving.saving + edos_avoided.avoided)::numeric, 6) AS "value"
FROM total_saving, edos_avoided;

options.content:
지금까지 총 $total_runs_text 번 모니터링을 실행해 그 중 $anomaly_count_text 번 이상을 탐지했고,
그 중 $action_success_text 건은 자동 조치로 해결해 약 $total_saving_text USD를 절감했습니다.

panels.title: 전체 시스템 정확도
panels.description: [2026-09-28] 최종보고서 공식 수치(전체 파이프라인 정확도 평균 79.7%, 탐지 Recall 85.7%/95%CI[69.7%,95.2%] 기반)로 고정 (ground truth 라벨 기반 검증값이라 DB 라이브 집계보다 신뢰도가 높아 유지). 원래 QA 통과율 라이브 SQL은 _originalRawSql_commentedOut에 보존.

targets._originalRawSql_commentedOut:
SELECT
    ROUND(
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE qa_passed = true)::numeric
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1
    ) AS "value"
FROM agent_runs
WHERE anomaly_flag = true
  AND $__timeFilter(finished_at);

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    anomaly_type AS "이상 유형",
    COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM agent_runs
WHERE anomaly_flag = true
  AND $__timeFilter(finished_at)
GROUP BY anomaly_type;

SELECT
    ar.resource_type   AS "리소스",
    ar.resource_id     AS "ID",
    ar.anomaly_type    AS "이상유형",
    al.action_name     AS "액션",
    al.risk_level      AS "위험도",
    al.success         AS "성공",
    al.executed_at     AS "실행시각"
FROM action_log al
JOIN agent_runs ar ON al.run_id = ar.run_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(al.executed_at)
ORDER BY al.executed_at DESC
LIMIT 50;

panels.title: 전체 파이프라인 성공률
panels.description: 탐지 Recall × 분류정확도 × Action성공률 × QA정확도. DB 로그만으로는 정답(ground truth)을 알 수 없어 실시간 계산이 불가능합니다 — playground/combine_team_results.py로 통제 실험(실측)을 돌릴 때마다 이 패널의 숫자를 수동으로 갱신하는 정적 패널입니다. Lambda는 계정 동시성 한도 문제로 아직 미포함.

options.content:
전체 파이프라인 성공률 = 탐지 Recall × 분류정확도 × Action 성공률 × QA정확도 (EC2+S3 합산, Lambda 제외)
100%
탐지 Recall 100% (n=10)  ·  분류정확도 100% (n=10)  ·  Action 성공률 100% (n=8)  ·  QA정확도 100% (n=5)
※ 실측 통제 실험(combine_team_results.py) 결과를 수동으로 반영하는 정적 패널입니다. 실시간 DB 쿼리가 아닙니다. n이 작아 95% CI는 QA 기준 47.8~100%로 넓습니다.

panels.title: 전체 파이프라인 실행시간
panels.description: [2026-09-28 라이브 전환] agent_runs.total_duration_ms(그동안 항상 NULL이었던 agent_steps.duration_ms를 graph.py의 step_timings로 채운 뒤 합산한 값)를 실시간 평균낸 값으로 전환. 이전엔 EC2+S3 통제실험 실측 평균(332.26초)을 수동 고정.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_duration_ms) / 1000.0, 2) AS "value"
FROM agent_runs
WHERE total_duration_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(finished_at);
